instructions: Generate the image from the prompt. Every REQUIRED element must be inside its box (±10%).
prompt:
Wide 16:9 wallpaper, 1920x1080. A quiet alpine lake under twin snow peaks at dusk, a small cabin glowing on the far shore.
Style: Studio Ghibli inspired pastoral landscape, gentle rolling wildflower hills, cozy rustic cottage, warm nostalgic summer afternoon, soft breeze. Time of day: dusk. Mood: calm. Palette, main color first: #2B4C7E, #F2A65A, #E8E2D0.

COMPOSITION. Every REQUIRED element below must be clearly visible at its position. Positions are percent of the frame: x 0 is the left edge, y 0 is the top edge.
1. [S2] Twin snow peaks: two snow-capped mountains, the left one taller. Far layer, upper center, large (x 16–82%, y 14–60%). REQUIRED.
2. [S4] Cabin light: small wooden cabin with one warm lit window. Middle layer, middle right, small (x 68–77%, y 53–63%). REQUIRED.
3. [S1] Dusk sky: gradient from deep blue to warm orange, first stars. Near (front) layer, top center, dominant, fills most of the frame (x 0–100%, y 0–42%). REQUIRED.
4. [S3] Alpine lake: still water mirroring the peaks. Near (front) layer, bottom center, dominant, fills most of the frame (x 0–100%, y 64–100%). REQUIRED.
5. [S7] Mountain: mountain range with clear peaks. Near (front) layer, upper center, large (x 20–80%, y 20–65%). Optional.
6. [S5] Lake mist: thin low mist over the water. Effect overlay layer, lower center, medium (x 4–96%, y 58–70%). Optional.
7. [S6] Mist: soft low mist band. Effect overlay layer, center, medium (x 5–95%, y 50–64%). REQUIRED.

Depth, back to front: Twin snow peaks → Cabin light → Dusk sky → Alpine lake → Mountain → Lake mist → Mist.
This image will be animated. Keep cabin light as one clean, continuous area with soft edges (glow); Keep dusk sky as one clean, continuous area with soft edges (glow); Keep alpine lake as one clean, continuous area with soft edges (ripple); Keep mountain as one clean, continuous area with soft edges (glow); Keep lake mist as one clean, continuous area with soft edges (drift); Keep mist as one clean, continuous area with soft edges (drift). Do not let other objects overlap those areas.
One continuous scene from one camera. Do not include: text, letters, logos, watermark, people, animals, borders, split panels.
